prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preparing Your Desktop Pet Environment", "Initializing desktop hardware graphics and background task manager...", "Desktop Graphic Engine Warmup", "Verifying screen display coordinates and overlay permissions"]
1: ["Audio Controls Configured!", "Your companion is ready to respond to your voice and desktop audio triggers."]
2: ["Welcome to Your New Desktop Companion", "Review how to quickly access, hide, and summon your pet from any workspace.", "System tray toggle icon active"]
3: ["Adoption Details Verified", "Your custom pet traits and certificate have been successfully compiled."]
4: ["Choose Your Onboarding Path", "Your account is active. Select how you would like to adopt your pet."]
5: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Profile", "Secure your desktop pet progress and multi-device cloud settings.", "Quick single-click authentication"]
6: ["Processing your photos into a desktop companion model...", "AI Pet Model Generation Active"]
7: ["You Are All Set!", "Your desktop companion is active in your taskbar and ready to interact."]
8: ["Desktop pets live quietly in your system tray and can be hidden or summoned with a single click at any time."]
9: ["Checking Desktop Display Compatibility", "Estimated launch time: 10 seconds", "Screen resolution check complete"]
